d: The squad helps out a fellow law enforcement officer by investigating the mysterious death of her daughter. Captain Raydor focuses her audit efforts on Detective Sanchez.
Brenda solicits Captain Raydor's help investigating allegations of brutality. Brenda's attorney (MARK PELLEGRINO) starts deposing the squad about the "Shootin' Newton" case.
The Baylor family offers to settle with Brenda in the civil suit against her, but the deal may be too good to be true. KEN HOWARD guest stars.
A popular high school teacher is killed. The squad works on the case, but Jane is preoccupied with Lt. Martinez's (AMAURY NOLASCO) seeming favoritism towards his own drug unit.
Frankie Jr. is brought in to help with a gruesome murder case involving a youth hockey league. Cailin (EMILEE WALLACE) asks to stay with Maura.
Jane and Maura begin a simulation of investigating serial killer Charles Hoyt's murders at a symposium for law enforcement, and come across a horrifying discovery.
Jane turns to Lt. Martinez (AMAURY NOLASCO) for help in a case she believes may have been an attempt to conceal drug trafficking, but he seems to be thwarting her investigation.
A mock trial advisor (A'DA ALISON WOOLFOLK) dies during a competition. Meanwhile, Jane is concerned that Angela may be hiding financial issues. DOUG SAVANT also guest stars.
Summer finale: Conflicting evidence muddies a case. Maura debates taking in her paroled grandfather (RICHARD HERD). Jane and Casey (CHRIS VANCE) evaluate where things stand.
When a kidnapper who dresses as a clown reemerges after 20+ years, the squad digs for clues from the unsolved abductions of 1988. Jane and Casey (CHRIS VANCE) become more serious.
A singer/guitar player is brutally and mysteriously stabbed in a bar -- but did the victim have something to hide? Jane's dad (CHAZZ PALMINTERI) returns, and he's got shocking news.
A food truck chef dies suddenly, prompting many questions. Tommy (COLIN EGGLESFIELD) announces plans that have Angela excited. Maura's birth mother (SHARON LAWRENCE) reaches out.

st: You're Gonna Miss Me When I'm Gone
d: Homeland Security steps in when a senator's daughter is murdered. Tommy (COLIN EGGLESFIELD) and Frankie get into a fight. Jane reveals shocking news that could be life-changing.
In the season premiere, a jogger's murder takes on more urgency as Jane realizes the motive was theft ... of the woman's baby. Maura and Frankie face the aftermath of their kiss.
As the team tries to unravel a bizarre case, they deal with the loss of their close friend and colleague, Detective Barry Frost.
The squad investigates the shooting of a deputy sheriff.
A high school principal is shot while trying to turn his school around in the midst of a scandal, but the team soon realizes their case overlaps with an existing FBI investigation.
